name: pen-fight-arena
description: Pen Fight Arena - realtime 3D online multiplayer pen fighting game with server-authoritative Rapier physics.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pfa/server && npm run build --workspace @pfa/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @pfa/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @pfa/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @pfa/client
